scope.flow: Dynamic swap fee calculation and application via DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee() and CLFactory.getSwapFee()
scope.environment: On-chain AMM factory with dynamic fee module
evidence: The dynamic fee system contains a cconflicting fee caps between `DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee()` and `CLFactory.getSwapFee()` which renders the dynamic fee mechanism ineffective. The `DynamicSwapFeeModule` allows fees up to 500,000 (50%) internally, but `CLFactory.getSwapFee()` rejects any fee above 100,000 (10%), causing the system to always fall back to basic tick spacing fees.
We can see in DynamicSwapFeeModule that the MAX_FEE_CAP is set to 500,000.
And in CLFactory the getSwapFee function rejects any fee above 100,000 (10%), upon which it falls back to the default tick spacing fee.

As a result, any dynamically calculated fee above 10% gets rejected reducing potential protocol revenue. Potential user discounts applied in `getFee()` are lost when the factory rejects the final fee. And the 50% anti-MEV protection cap becomes unusable, leaving pools vulnerable to maximal extractable value attacks during high volatility
